summary:
Our project is a health monitoring system for astronauts during missions. We worked on a system that tracks real time vitals of astronauts in space suits with the assumption that the data will be collected through various sensors already in the astronaut's suit.
We took a very direct approach that focuses on tracking health important health markers in the body during space mission. Our system has a frontend that is mainly the interactive ui for the astronaut. On the ui, the user can check trend for different markers, see recommendations and also get notifications and alerts as to their progress with respect to certain tasks that they have to do. This is mainly remainders for exercises that are required to keep them fit and ready for earth.
The backend is basically consists of an algorithm that reads all the data coming through and gives a continuous analysis of the trends and data to provide recommendations for the astronaut and try to understand its implications. 
In one sentence we built an app that makes sure that the astronaut is in good shape.
I think it is important because, although health hazards exist in any profession we, it is our duty to ensure that with advances in technology we can better protect space scientists.
FYI: We had a few ideas and specifically wanted to do more on radiations and DNA but we couldn't due to certain restrictions.
details: The system(app) keeps track of an astronaut's vitals, Analyses and provides an interface to view the analysis, displays results and or implications of the analysis and provides recommendation for issues and anomalies/interruptions. It also provides remainders as to the completion of tasks to be completed at different points in the journey. The project provides a real time view of the astronaut's wellbeing status. The project was made using vs code, with help from claude ai and the vs code's copilot. GitHub was used for collaboration between the team. The project was written in html, and mostly react for the frontend and python for the backend. We did the whole project using only laptops. Our project's creativity is in the idea of providing a very simple and lightweight model that has just enough functions. Not too much to overwhem the user and not too little to be non-functional. Our team considered mainly the types of vitals, their relevance based on what nasa gave and most importantly the simplicity and usabilty of the product.
